verses.text: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
"Count the Kohathites among the Levites by their clans and families.
Count all the men from thirty to fifty years old who come to work at the Tent of Meeting.
This is the work of the Kohathites at the Tent of Meeting: they will take care of the most holy things.
When the camp is ready to move, Aaron and his sons must go in, take down the curtain that hangs in front, and cover the Covenant Box with it.
Then they must put a covering of fine leather over it, spread a cloth of solid blue on top, and put its carrying poles in place.
Over the table for the holy bread they must spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the jars for drink offerings. The bread that is always there must stay on it.
They must spread a red cloth over these, cover it with fine leather, and put its poles in place.
They must take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand, its lamps, its wick cutters, its trays, and all the jars for the oil used with it.
They must wrap it and all its tools in a covering of fine leather and put it on a carrying frame.
Over the gold altar they must spread a blue cloth, cover it with fine leather, and put its poles in place.
They must take all the tools used for serving in the holy place, wrap them in a blue cloth, cover them with fine leather, and put them on a carrying frame.
They must clear the ashes from the bronze altar and spread a purple cloth over it.
Then they must put on it all the tools used at the altar: the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the bowls. They must spread a covering of fine leather over it and put its poles in place.

When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy furniture and all the holy tools, and the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites will come to carry them. But they must not touch the holy things, or they will die. These are the things from the Tent of Meeting that the Kohathites must carry.

Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet incense, the regular grain offering, and the anointing oil. He will be in charge of the whole Holy Tent and everything in it, the holy place and its furniture."
The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
"Do not let the Kohathite clans be destroyed from among the Levites.
Do this for them so that they will live and not die when they come near the most holy things: Aaron and his sons must go in and give each man his job and tell him what to carry.
But the Kohathites must not go in to look at the holy things, even for a moment, or they will die."
The LORD said to Moses,
"Count the Gershonites also, by their families and clans.
Count all the men from thirty to fifty years old who come to serve at the Tent of Meeting.
This is the work of the Gershonite clans, the work they do and what they carry:
They will carry the curtains of the Holy Tent, the Tent of Meeting itself, its covering and the outer covering of fine leather, the curtain at the door of the Tent of Meeting,

the curtains of the courtyard around the Holy Tent and the altar, the curtain at the entrance of the courtyard, the ropes, and all the equipment used for this work. They will do all the work connected with these things.
All the work of the Gershonites, both carrying and other work, must be done under the direction of Aaron and his sons. Tell them exactly what they are responsible to carry.
This is the work of the Gershonite clans at the Tent of Meeting. They will work under the direction of Ithamar, son of Aaron the priest.
Count the Merarites by their clans and families.
Count all the men from thirty to fifty years old who come to work at the Tent of Meeting.
This is what they must carry as part of their work at the Tent of Meeting: the frames of the Holy Tent, its crossbars, its posts, and its bases,
and the posts all around the courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, ropes, and all their equipment and everything used with them. Tell each man by name exactly what he must carry.
This is the work of the Merarite clans at the Tent of Meeting, under the direction of Ithamar, son of Aaron the priest."
Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the community counted the Kohathites by their clans and families.
They counted all the men from thirty to fifty years old who came to work at the Tent of Meeting.
Counted by clans, they numbered two thousand seven hundred fifty.
This was the total of the Kohathite clans who served at the Tent of Meeting. Moses and Aaron counted them as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
The Gershonites were counted by their clans and families.
All the men from thirty to fifty years old who came to work at the Tent of Meeting
were counted by their clans and families, and they numbered two thousand six hundred thirty.
This was the total of the Gershonite clans who served at the Tent of Meeting. Moses and Aaron counted them as the LORD had commanded.
The Merarites were counted by their clans and families.
All the men from thirty to fifty years old who came to work at the Tent of Meeting
were counted by their clans, and they numbered three thousand two hundred.
This was the total of the Merarite clans. Moses and Aaron counted them as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel counted all the Levites by their clans and families.
All the men from thirty to fifty years old who came to do the work of serving and carrying at the Tent of Meeting
numbered eight thousand five hundred eighty.
As the LORD had commanded through Moses, each man was counted and given his work and told what to carry. So they were counted, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
